summary: The PDF supports every people count in the c116 form: 456 randomized (p. 6, Figure 4), 280 analyzed (p. 6, Section 4.2), and 62, 72, 88, and 58 by arm (p. 9, Figure 8), and it prints no per-arm randomized or exclusion counts, so the nulls are right and 176 is simply 456 - 280.
